target_customer: Software teams using multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)
problem: Developers copy and paste between their own and teammates' coding agents; context and decisions get stuck in single chat sessions.
business_model: Open source core with hosted free-to-start tier and paid self-host setup help; pricing not found
product_category: Multi-agent messaging infrastructure for developer tools

founders.name: Will Washburn
prior_employers: Tailwind (14 years scaling a marketing SaaS company, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page; IBTimes places him in Boston.

founders.name: Khaliq Gant
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page; IBTimes places him in Oslo.

competitors.name: agmsg
competitors.what: Cross-CLI agent messaging via shared SQLite

competitors.name: Google A2A protocol
competitors.what: Open standard for agent discovery and messaging

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time cross-vendor messaging with permission boundaries and shared history is moderate engineering; the open source repo has about 1.1k stars per the site.

defensibility.rationale: Value grows when teammates also connect, but protocols are open and vendors can ship native messaging.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Anthropic already shipped Agent Teams for Claude to Claude coordination; cross-vendor remains open as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Multi-agent coding workflows spread in 2025 and 2026; Gant describes seeing the coordination problem while running several agents (IBTimes, 2026-09-30).

identity.visual_style: Clean product-focused layout with README banners
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and friendly: 'Your agents should talk to each other, just not through you.'

branding.brand_signature: Tagline about agents talking without going through you
branding.community_and_virality: Open source repo with about 1.1k stars per its site; directories call it Slack for agents.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name shared with unrelated companies named Agent Relay and Relay; some contributor press, no brand-level coverage.

outcome_analysis: Active and early in YC Fall 2026. Open source distribution and an experienced founding pair are strengths, while native vendor features such as Claude Agent Teams threaten the wedge. No outcome yet.
notes: Caplight reports $500K on 2026-09-01 from Hustle Fund and others; single aggregator, unverified, so the round amount is left null. Dealroom's Agent Relay (Jacob Bank) is a different company. Location conflicts: YC says San Francisco, IBTimes says Boston and Oslo. Founder education for Washburn not found.
